Kennedy Center Removes Landmark 'Blue' Sculpture

The Kennedy Center has begun the removal of its landmark 'Blue' sculpture from its campus. Crews were observed preparing for and carrying out the dismantling of the outdoor artwork. The reasons for the abrupt removal were not immediately stated in the coverage.
